lines.en: Bare feet on the dirt road.
Village dust on my trouser cuffs.

lines.zh: 我走得急，要去看看那边。
lines.en: I walk fast; I need to check over there.

lines.zh: 每一步都不重，可我用力很稳。
lines.en: Light steps, but firmly planted.
I am not used to flying. I will walk.
Grass bends under my feet.
I walk around the seedlings.
Wind fills my clothes.

lines.zh: 两只手垂在身侧，随时能抬。
lines.en: Hands at my sides, ready to rise.
From one end of the village to the other.

lines.zh: 脚上有老茧，是在岛上磨的。
lines.en: Calluses from the island are still on my feet.

lines.zh: 我赤脚走过村口那条土路。
lines.en: I walk the dirt road past the village gate barefoot.
Standing, scratching my head.
Quieter here than I expected.
I am a little hungry.

lines.zh: 我在想，该怎么控制这股力。
lines.en: I am wondering how to control this power.
I look down at my palms.
The wind feels good.
Standing too long makes me restless.
I count the people on the road.
My waistband is loose. I tighten it.
The ground here is softer than the island's.
I am waiting for someone.
Ki circles once in my palm.
I look up. The clouds move slowly.
Are you from this village?
Your hands are steady. You have trained.
Do not be afraid. I do not strike lightly.
I am Uub. And you?

lines.zh: 我看起来不像，其实很能打。
lines.en: I may not look it, but I can fight.
Have you come to make trouble too?
Talk first, then fight.

lines.zh: 我身上这股力，我还没摸透。
lines.en: I have not mastered this power yet.
My ki is not yet settled.
I grew up on an island.
Your clothes are nice.
I am checking whether you mean harm.
My fist rises, then lowers.
People around here fear me.

lines.zh: 你眼里的力气比嘴上多。
lines.en: There is more force in your eyes than in your words.
Say what you have to say.

lines.zh: 打不打得过，试了才知道。
lines.en: Whether I can win, we will find out.
Blood at the corner of my mouth.
I eased back.
I am fine. I am tough.
That force feels like my master's.
I grit my teeth and go again.
My knuckles are scraped.
I do not cry out.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想起训练的滋味。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of what training feels like.
Is that food in your hand?
I can eat a great deal in a day.
Give me a piece and I will do the work.
That smells good.

lines.zh: 岛上从没人给我留过饭。
lines.en: No one on the island ever saved me a meal.
Do not take it away. I have not looked.
One bowl is enough. I am not greedy.
Is that flatbread in your hand?
I can eat less than that.
My stomach growled. Embarrassing.
Hey, you bumped me.
I did not mean to hit you.
Move back a bit.
You lost your footing, right?
My strength is great. I must be careful.
There is a stone here.
Let us pass each other.
You are not hurt, are you? Stand up.
Do not push me. I might overdo it.
I have only just grown up.
I have never thought about it.

lines.zh: 村里的人还不太认识我。
lines.en: The village barely knows me yet.
I cannot even look after myself.
After I understand my power.
Do not joke about that.
I am red from the sun, not that.
I want to go back to the island first.
I will not answer that.
Let us change the subject.
There is a fruit on the ground.
I pick it up and wipe it.
Who dropped this?
My grip is strong. I must be gentle.
A rag. Still usable.
Where should I put this?
I bend quickly.
Not mine. I return it.
Into my pocket for now.
We are really doing this?
Then I will not hold back.
Take this kick first.
Ki gathers in my fist.
This time I have you.
I will not let you hurt anyone.
I learned this on the island.
Stand ready and hold still.
I will try to make it quick.
Do not run toward the houses.
Only one target.
Then let us try it.
I count only three.
If I cannot back down, I go forward.
The blast is ready.
Come. I am not afraid of you.
I watch his feet.
He moved to the left.
I shift forward with him.
The blast grows hot in my hand.
Give him a moment more.
His weapon looks too small.
I do not want to break this wall.
His breathing is getting ragged.
I circle to his flank.
I can pull this blow.
Bare feet make no sound on dirt.
He thinks I only use fists.
I will come from above.
He backed to the crossroads.
Good. This is the spot.
Hold still where you are.
I strike right now.
A fast kick.
Three quick punches.
An elbow to his shoulder.
The air tears at my punch.
He retreats; I follow.
A sweeping kick takes him down.
I did not use full strength.
He blocked it; his arm shakes.
Again, both hands this time.
I charge in with my shoulder.
The wave pushes him along.
I stop and see if he stands.
Why have you stopped?
I walk in from the village gate.
Island dirt still on me.
First time I have been here.
Who is out looking for me?

lines.zh: 先站稳，我不习惯这么多人。
lines.en: Steady. I am not used to crowds.
I am strong. Please stand back.
I look up at this sky.
The wind is different from the island's.

lines.zh: 裤腿上还有海水干的痕。
lines.en: Salt stains still on my trousers.

lines.zh: 我来了，是听说这里有麻烦。
lines.en: I came because I heard there was trouble.
I clench my fist.
I did not come to show off.
Ki circles at my feet.
This village looks small.
Does anyone need help?
I will try not to break anything.
Let me see the situation first.
Flame licks my arm. Hot.
Landing from height, my knees bend.

lines.zh: 在水里，我的力气用不上。
lines.en: Underwater, my strength is useless.
The blast throws me back.
An arrow sticks in my calf.
What art is this?
My stomach is roaring.
Lightning leaves me numb all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里我抓不到任何实的东西。
lines.en: In the void I cannot grab hold of anything solid.
